note: The claim is that /collection's row and the decklist row state a cost the same way, by rendering the same component. `view` names each route's OWN view file. The collection row used to draw a mana VALUE beside colour IDENTITY, which folds in what a card's abilities cost — so `Abzan Monument`, whose cost is `{2}`, read as a four-colour two-drop.

rows.label: /decks/[id] — the pattern the collection row now matches
